assembly: Fit the jack carrier, A01-jack, the middle carrier and A01-middle as in Stage10.
Mate the GHR housings into J-SIG:middle and J-PWR:middle along -z to +z from the panel side, with the front panel off.
Lay each bundle over its notch saddle and fit R1/R2.
Form the free loop at the local end and mate J-SIG:local and J-PWR:local from the rear, left of the A01-middle edge (x < 232).
Fit the core onto the DIN connector and connect K-PWR last. Service: disconnect K-PWR, then withdraw the core 40 mm; J-SIG and J-PWR are not touched.

assembly: Fit the jack carrier, A01-jack, the middle carrier and A01-middle as in Stage10.
Mate the GHR housings into J-SIG:middle and J-PWR:middle along -z to +z from the panel side, with the front panel off.
Fan each bundle out into one layer before the A01-middle edge, slide it through the slot over the rail with the liner and comb, and gather it again inside the ring.

Fit the core onto the DIN connector and connect K-PWR last. Service: disconnect K-PWR, then withdraw the core 40 mm; J-SIG and J-PWR are not touched.
